## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Deformation interfaces
//
// Named space warps as first-class values: a deformation is a pure point-to-point
// map. Thin aliases of IProcedural over Point2D/Point3D so catalogs (Twist, Bend,
// Taper, ...) are discoverable and library helpers can constrain on them. Apply
// to geometry through IDeformable2D/IDeformable3D (transforms.concepts.plato);
// modulate with IScalarField2D/3D weights (fields.concepts.plato) — do not bake
// falloff into each warp. Evaluation verb is Eval (inherited); argument order is
// deformation first, point second.

// A pure planar space warp: maps every Point2D to a Point2D. Implements are
// parametric structs (Shear2D, Taper2D, ...); apply with
// `geom.Deform(d)` / `d.Eval(p)`.
interface IDeformation2D
    inherits IProcedural<Point2D, Point2D>
{ }

// A pure spatial space warp: maps every Point3D to a Point3D. Implements are
// parametric structs (Twist3D, Bend3D, Taper3D, ...); apply with
// `geom.Deform(d)` / `d.Eval(p)`.
interface IDeformation3D
    inherits IProcedural<Point3D, Point3D>
{ }
```
